Red Lantern Corps

Rankorr

A human perspective inside the rage Corps.

Jack Moore, known as Rankorr, brings a human perspective to the Red Lantern Corps. His story begins in Red Lanterns, after the 2011 War of the Green Lanterns.

Continuity: Main DC comics continuity; this profile follows the cited era rather than asserting a permanent present-day status.

Affiliation
Red Lantern Corps
First appearance
Red Lanterns #1 (2011) as Jack Moore; #6 (2012) as Rankorr
Story history — History and later developments — spoilers

Moore is a young Englishman whose grief and anger lead him into the rage Corps. The early series contrasts his experience with the alien members already following Atrocitus. Red Lanterns #6 explicitly introduces the human called Rankorr to the wider cast. Earlier Red Lantern appearances are background reading rather than chapters of his own story.

Key Stories

  • Red Lanterns
    Opening arc: #1–6 (2011–2012)

Reading order

  • Red Lanterns (2011-2015)
